body:
august 13, 2012: she announced red from her living room on a webcast, 70,000 fans watching, then premiered a brand-new song to close it. three albums into her career, "we are never ever getting back together" became her first hot 100 no. 1.

longlivets.com/?era=red&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=on-this-day
why: Calendar slot 2026-08-13 15:00Z X, heartbeat:on-this-day, hook "the contradiction" — three albums and five country No. 1s deep, and she had never topped the Hot 100 until this night. Genuine dated Vault match: "Red announced live from her living room, on a Google+ Hangout" (2012-08-13, sourced Wikipedia + Rolling Stone + The Hollywood Reporter) gives the worldwide webcast from Nashville, 70,000+ at the stream’s peak, and the same-night premiere of "We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together" going on to become her first career Hot 100 No. 1. Album count checked against the Vault: debut (2006), Fearless (2008), Speak Now (2010). Rollout/chart lore only, outside every blocklist topic. | 2026-08-12 Taylor-photo standard (issue #2031, Joey directive): attached a real credited photograph of Taylor from the repo corpus (apps/web/lib/longlive/lenses.ts), rehosted under /social/library/photos/. Campaign renamed to a STORY-UNIQUE value: findPostedDuplicate treats same platform+campaign as an already-posted duplicate, so the old thematic bucket campaigns (heartbeat:*) would have false-skipped every post in a bucket after its first one landed. Visible credit line omitted from the body only because it would exceed X’s 280 weighted chars; the credit is recorded in mediaCredit.
